content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

The gold standard is roughly 0.7–1.0 grams of protein per pound of bodyweight (1.6–2.2 g per kg) daily when you're in a calorie surplus and training hard. That said, anywhere in the 0.8–1.0 g/kg range works well for most people—beyond that, you're just adding calories.

What matters more is hitting that target consistently, eating enough total calories to support muscle growth, and training with progressive overload. Ain't nothin' but a peanut if you're eating protein but not pushing the weights! 💪
